task.title: Qlib rolling-window OOS pipeline + eval
task.summary_zh: 在 services/research/qlib/ 之上實作 rolling-window / OOS pipeline。建在已 archived 的 QLIB-001 dataset manifest 基礎上，產出 OOS metrics 並寫回 ExperimentRun。
acceptance: rolling_pipeline.py exposes run(strategy_spec_ref window_days) returning ExperimentRun dict with producer_run_id and lineage
oos_eval.py exposes evaluate(experiment_run) returning oos_metrics dict (sharpe sortino max_dd ic)
test_rolling_pipeline.py covers 1 happy-path and 1 fail-fast scenario (insufficient data) with pytest -q exit 0
smoke run produces evaluation_summary linked back to a strategy_spec artifact id
task.next: Finalized OSS-QLIB-002 after Claude review approval. Task commit 935fcb4c adds rolling_pipeline.py, oos_eval.py, test_rolling_pipeline.py, and contract.md. handoffs.message: Ready for review: added Qlib rolling-window OOS ExperimentRun pipeline, OOS evaluator, tests, and contract. New artifacts: services/research/qlib/rolling_pipeline.py, services/research/qlib/oos_eval.py, services/research/qlib/test_rolling_pipeline.py, services/research/qlib/contract.md. Output is schema-valid ExperimentRun with producer_run_id/lineage/evaluation_summary in metadata, strategy_spec_artifact_id linked to qlib-tw-cross-sectional-alpha-spec-v1, deployment_stage=none, no registry/runtime/broker/order side effects. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest services/research/qlib/test_rolling_pipeline.py -q => 2 passed; py_compile rolling/oos/test => passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest services/research/qlib -q => 35 passed; CLI smoke wrote /tmp/oss_qlib_002_smoke.json with 13950 OOS samples, 279 OOS periods, sharpe/sortino/max_dd/ic present.
Chair reassigned review from Codex2 to Claude: Codex2 pause blocks an older review item; Claude is an available non-owner reviewer after stale OSS-STAT approval is denied.

Review approved: all acceptance criteria met. run() produces schema-valid ExperimentRun with producer_run_id/lineage/evaluation_summary; evaluate() returns sharpe/sortino/max_dd/ic; 2 tests pass (happy-path + fail-fast); 35 total qlib tests pass; no trailing whitespace; deployment_stage=none; no side effects. Returning to Codex for finalization.
